source: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Flow of Funds (JSON API files FL02_en and FL01_en), used under the Open Government Data License, version 1.0
note: All Taiwan holders is the sum of the nine domestic sectors and everything issued is what the issuers owe, so adding every row counts money more than once; the ownership book uses the holders only. For shares, transactions are only money paid for newly issued shares. Amounts are billions of New Taiwan dollars.
